'''Loku Kanoloa''' was a male [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]] that was aligned with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
[[File:Coordinated_Attack_IA-RtH.png|thumb|left|250px|Kanoloa using his marksman skills on Hoth]]
{{Quote|Sometimes study isn't enough, and you're forced to learn on the fly.|Loku Kanoloa|<ref name="Return to Hoth" />}}
Prior to joining the Rebel Alliance, Loku Kanoloa was a member of the [[Mon Cala Special Forces]], with whom he performed several missions. After joining the Rebellion, he put his skills as a sniper to good use. At one point, with very little lead time, he executed a mission to rescue several of his fellow Rebels from Imperial custody.<ref name="Constant Vigilance" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] forced them to evacuate, Kanoloa aided the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[MHD-19/Legends|MHD-19]] and the Human female [[operative]] [[Verena Talos/Legends|Verena Talos]] in returning to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to evacuate some colonists from the Empire's grasp.<ref name="Return to Hoth" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We all use the same battlefield. Some use it better.|Loku Kanoloa|<ref name="Return to Hoth" />}}
[[File:Constant_Vigilance_RtH.png|thumb|right|250px|Kanoloa taking aim at a stormtrooper.]]
Loku Kanoloa was a very skilled and deadly marksman, and occasionally supported allies with sniping skills and a coordinated strike.<ref name="Return to Hoth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loku Kanoloa is one of three hero characters in the [[Return to Hoth (expansion)|''Return to Hoth'']] expansion pack for the tactical land-based RPG game ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
